title: Lena Dunham Welcomes First Child Via Surrogate
summary: Lena Dunham has announced the birth of her first child, born via surrogate. This news comes eight years after she underwent a hysterectomy. The actress shared the announcement on social media.
summary_points: Lena Dunham announced the birth of her first child.
The child was born via surrogate.
The announcement was made eight years after Dunham's hysterectomy.
